description: Schema for relationship type entities that define roles and validation for relationship instances. The referenced schema must include relationship.json in its composition to ensure instances have 'relationship' in entity-types.

schema.description: Relationship type schemas should reference a schema that includes relationship.json

participant-property-schema.$comment: A participant role: either a singleton entity reference or an array of them. Each may optionally declare x-entity-types (allowed entity types); absent means any entity type is allowed.
